title: The Agreement Hinge
headline: Why Agreeing With a Thought Matters More Than Having It
tagline: A thought can enter your mind without receiving permission to become your belief.
seo_title: Agreeing With a Thought vs. Having It: Genesis 3 and Temptation | TheWrkShop
seo_description: A thought can knock on the door without receiving the keys to the house. A devotional for men on agreement, Genesis 3 and taking thoughts captive.
verse_text: ….we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

scriptures.text: ….we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
Each person is tempted when they are dragged away by their own evil desire and enticed.

items: Event.
Thought.
Attention.
Interpretation.
Then we arrive at a critical moment: agreement.
A thought appearing is not the same as believing it.
A temptation appearing is not the same as obeying it.
A feeling arising is not the same as surrendering to it.

blocks.text: The question is: will it receive a verdict?

items: “They don’t respect me.”
“You deserve better.”
“Everybody is ahead of you.”
“God isn’t going to come through.”
“You’ll never change.”
“Just this once.”
Some thoughts contain truth. Some are fear, temptation, old rehearsals or ordinary mental noise.
The Christian task is not to panic because thoughts exist.
It is to test what seeks authority.

blocks.text: A thought can knock on the door without receiving the keys to the house.

items: Agreement is not always a conscious sentence.
Sometimes it sounds like:
“Exactly.”
“I knew it.”
“That proves it.”
Agreement gives an interpretation somewhere to settle.
The thought may have entered uninvited.
Agreement gives it permission to stay.
The serpent asks, “Did God really say….?”
He does not begin by grabbing the fruit.
He introduces an alternative interpretation.
God says death. The serpent says elevation.
God says trust. The serpent implies deprivation.
The tree has not changed.
The interpretive frame has.
Speech affected sight.
Sight affected desire.
Desire affected action.
The battle was underway before the bite.
Feelings can be witnesses without becoming judges.
Desire can be loud without being Lord.
Relief is not the same as restoration.
Don’t sign an agreement you haven’t tested.

blocks.text: This thought has appeared. I have not yet given it authority.
